definitions.explanation: Hair whose tip has split into two or more strands, like a branching twig ({枝|えだ}), usually from dryness or damage.

examples.japanese: {枝毛|えだげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: I've been getting more split ends.

examples.japanese: {枝毛|えだげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my split ends trimmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}て→当てる：01864_ateru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}んで→傷む：10061_itamu⟧{枝毛|えだげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: If you overdo the heat from the hair dryer, your hair gets damaged and split ends form easily.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枝毛|えだげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to get split ends
- {枝毛|えだげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut off split ends
- {枝毛|えだげ}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: split-end prevention (on hair-care products)

RELATED WORDS:
- {切|き}れ{毛|げ}: broken hairs
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}む→傷む：10061_itamu⟧: hair gets damaged
- {毛先|けさき}: the ends of the hair
